text:
Iris Lopez: Quick sync 1: we need a tiny docs PR to clarify Optimize Toolkit recommendations: prefer adaptive batch_tuning over fixed `batch_size`, add a note about quant profile fallbacks for older Llama forks.

Theo Martin: Agreed. I noticed users copy-pasting the Python snippet with `batch_size=128` and then hit tail latency spikes. Let's show a short adaptive example + migration snippet.

Samir Rao: Drafted a commit on branch docs/opt-adaptive-note: added example and a compact compatibility row: Llama-2-7B -> int8 OK, int4 experimental (quality regressions). Also fixed an internal link to /optimize/quant-compat. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4680

Iris Lopez: Nice. Can we include a one-liner about SDK rename: `max_batch` -> `batch_cap`? Small migration snippet to avoid support churn.

Samir Rao: Added it. Example: `configure(policy={"batch_cap": 48})` and a short sentence explaining semantics.

docs-ci: linkcheck failed: anchor mismatch on quant page. Samir: can you update the link target?

Samir Rao: Fixed and pushed. Docs preview is up: https://deploy-preview-4680--redwood-docs.netlify.app/optimize/adaptive.

Theo Martin: LGTM. Approving now. Follow-up: add a short FAQ note about when NOT to use adaptive tuning (very spiky traffic patterns).

Iris Lopez: Added FAQ. Merging after CI. Assigning docs-qa to sanity-check staging examples.
